description: bertholomus/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-EXL3-2.5bpw at immutable revision 366f8cb847b73efa7d998419e9632a84b602eea9 (the repository head; it differs from 67130854, the v0.2.0 pack commit, only in the model card): bertholomus's EXL3 conversion of mistralai/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B at f12dabdc (routed experts 2.5 bpw; attention, shared and dense 5.0 bpw; head 6.0 bpw; mul1 codebook), 72 layers, MLA attention with a sparse indexer, 128 routed experts (4 active) plus a shared expert, and a 1,048,576-token window. Text only: the vision encoder is not in the pack. draft/mtp_dspark.safetensors is Mistral's own draft head, unchanged. All 155 hashed files match the creator's sha256.txt. Weights are under the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight License (a modified MIT licence; condition 2 asks a Model-as-a-Service business to obtain a separate commercial licence from Mistral before commercial use); the licence is information, not a gate. What 2.5 bits costs against the original weights is not measured by the creator or here.
